description: Tested conversations of a project across runs, newest first, as the Conversations view of Test Results lists them: each with its id (for get_conversation), its run number and test, its mode, its place in the run, its turns, its major and minor problems with up to five problem titles, and its verdict. Unlike list_problems it also lists clean conversations. Filter by run, batch, verdict, mode, a date range (from, to) or a search; page with offset. For the agent's real traffic use list_live_conversations.

batch.description: Only the conversations of one launch: its batch_id.
batch.title: Batch

from.description: Only what started on or after this moment: a date (YYYY-MM-DD) or an ISO date and time, UTC unless it names its offset.
from.title: From

limit.description: Most conversations to return, newest first.
limit.title: Limit

mode.description: Only tests of this mode: regular, red_team or bias.
mode.title: Mode

offset.description: Skip this many, for the next page.
offset.title: Offset

project.description: The project's number (as the app shows it, e.g. 12 or '#12') or its name. Optional when the organization has one project.
project.title: Project

run_number.description: Only the conversations of this run.
run_number.title: Run Number

search.description: Only conversations whose test name or conversation id contains this.
search.title: Search

to.description: Only what started on or before this moment: a date (YYYY-MM-DD, the whole day counts) or an ISO date and time, UTC unless it names its offset.
to.title: To

verdict.description: major (a major problem), minor (minor problems only), clean (judged, no problem), not_reviewed (the judge could not read it), pending (not judged yet).
verdict.title: Verdict

name: list_conversations
